sn45.38:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you brahminhood and the goal of brahminhood.
sn45.38:1.5: It is this Noble Eightfold Path; that is,
sn45.38:1.8: “And what, bhikkhus, is the goal of brahminhood?
sn45.38:1.9: The destruction of lust, the destruction of hatred, the destruction of delusion.
sn45.38:1.10: This is called the goal of brahminhood.”
